name: 張瑋倫
objective: This course provides the knowledge you need to understand the role of information systems in modern organizations, with particular focus on E-commerce and E-business. Along with skills learned in your functional area, knowledge from this course will help you effectively use information technology for solving business problems.
課程進度(1-16週):
1 Orientation
2 Digital Transformation
3 Twin Transition /Case: Atos 
4 Understand the Use of AI in Business /Case: Grow 
5 Core AI Technologies /Case: PFN  
6 Psychology of Algorithm /Case: Intenseye 
7 Midterm week / group project time (OFF)
8 AI contest presentation
9 The Importance of IT /Case: Salesforce 
10 Business Process Reengineering  /Case: Sunrise Construction 
11 Enterprise Resource Planning /Case: VLF Hospital  
12 Customer Relationship Management /Case: Luckin Coffee  
13 Supply Chain Management /Case: Easy flower
14 Business Case Analysis and Presentation
